cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID. The July 2026 share clears a third only narrowly, on a population of 32.7 million.
cells.note: ONECI's July 2026 count of 11 million NNI holders is about 34% of the population, replacing the 2024 count of 8 million. It clears a third narrowly and nothing counts two-thirds.
